QQ NT (Electron-based). QQNT.framework. So QQ 6.9.81 on macOS is Electron-based (QQNT). Interception of recall = modify JS bundle, or better: use a plugin system. QQNT has a "lite-loader" ecosystem (LiteLoaderQQNT) on Windows; on macOS also possible.

Let me inspect: Resources/app or QQNT.framework contents.

Key: message recall interception. Approaches:
1. Patch app JS (renderer) to block `recall` event handling → convert recall tip into original message. That requires patching the renderer bundle (nt_msg / message service). Hard but doable.
2. Better and much easier: intercept at the protocol/logic layer — QQNT has `LiteLoaderQQNT` plugin API; plugin `anti-recall` hooks `ipcMain` channel `ns-ntApi` requests. Existing plugins like "LiteLoaderQQNT-Anti-Recall" work by hooking the main-process `session`'s message pipeline.

Actually the well-known approach on QQNT: in main process, hook `ElectronMessageChannel` / `ipcMain.emit` to intercept outgoing `nodeIKernelMsgService/sendMsg` etc. For anti-recall, the common approach: hook the main process handler for kernel push `onRecvMsg` and when msg element is a recall tip (elemType 11 = grey tip with recall), replace with the original content. But original content is gone from server... Actually recall notification contains the recalled msg seq and the original msg may still be in local DB. Many anti-recall plugins do: intercept `onMsgInfoListUpdate` / `onRecvMsg` where recall notification arrives and cancel it + keep original message displayed.

## assistant · 2026-11-08T09:01:01Z

Header pickle format: [UInt32 pickle_size=4][UInt32 json_size][UInt32 string_size?]... Standard asar: 

Bytes 0-3: UInt32LE = 4 (size of the size field)
Bytes 4-7: UInt32LE = size of the pickle (header size + 4)
Bytes 8-11: UInt32LE = header string length
Bytes 12...: JSON header

So: read 16 bytes: [0]=4, [4]=pickleSize, [8]=jsonLen. baseOffset = 8 + pickleSize.

My code read jsonBuf of headerPickleSize starting at 8, then JSON.parse of first jsonSize bytes — but jsonSize was readUInt32LE(4)=pickleSize. Fix: jsonLen at offset 8.

We can use `codesign --force --deep --sign - --entitlements qq.entitlements QQ-patched.app` — but --deep doesn't preserve per-binary entitlements (helpers need their own: e.g. Helper has app-sandbox too). Better to preserve original entitlements per binary: since only package.json and plugin files changed, only the *main app* signature is invalid (resource seal). Nested helpers still valid.

So: re-sign only the app bundle (top-level) with `--force --sign - --entitlements qq.entitlements` (not deep), which will re-seal resources. Nested code stays as is; `codesign` will verify nested code's signatures (they're intact).

But careful: signing an app with `--force --sign -` requires signing the main executable + resources. Ad-hoc signature has no team id, so `application-groups` entitlement (FN2V63AD2J.com.tencent) may fail validation... Application groups require the team prefix to match; ad-hoc has no team → could break IPC to the helper (they use app groups for shared container).

(b) Avoid touching the app bundle: put our patch in a *separate app bundle* that has its own signature? Any modification requires signing.
(c) Use the `versions/` mechanism: QQ loads app from `~/Library/Containers/.../QQ/versions/<version>/` — those are outside the .app, so no signature seal issue! The launcher checks `versions/config.json`; if curVersion dir exists with its own `app/package.json`, it may load from there. That's exactly how QQ hot-updates without re-signing the bundle. If we can make the launcher use a versioned build dir that we control, we win: no signature problem at all.

Look at the launcher logs: it checks `IsVersionsDirExist`, reads config, compares `config_current_version` vs `app_build_version`; `LoadFromDefaultFramework`. If versions/<curVersion>/ exists, it probably loads `<versions>/<cur>/app/...` as resourcesPath ("not mini app" else). Then integrity of that dir may be checked via application.json too — but the launcher seems to trust downloaded packages (they're verified by signature of the package, maybe).

- When someone recalls, the kernel sends onMsgInfoListUpdate with updated msg records. The renderer re-renders that message as "撤回" system text instead of content. Anti-recall plugins typically intercept this and replace the payload so the original content is retained, e.g. by rewriting the msg element/msgType back to the original.

In LiteLoaderQQNT's "防撤回" plugin (main process hook), it hooks `ipcMain.on("RM_IPCFROM_MAIN...")`? No — that plugin hooks the *renderer* via `ntApi` proxy in preload.

Alternatively there's a known approach of patching `onMsgInfoListUpdate` in renderer to keep old messages ("msgListCache").

Since we own the main process, alternative pragmatic approach: **snapshot all outgoing message pushes** (cache last N messages per chat). Then when a recall push arrives, immediately push a synthetic "系统提示" text message into the renderer with the original content: "「xxx」撤回了一条消息（内容：原文）". This requires only that we can *detect* recall pushes; the synthetic message can be pushed through the same channel with a cmdName we craft — the renderer might not accept unknown cmdName... but we can also just not bother: we can rewrite the recall push payload by replacing its elements with the cached original text and leaving msgType as normal (so the renderer renders the original content as if not recalled). This is exactly what anti-recall does, and rewriting needs payload knowledge.

    - if cmdName matches /MsgInfoListUpdate|onRecvMsg|MsgList|onMsg/ → process payload
- processPayload(payload, chan):

    For each msg record with msgId (or msgSeq):
      const prev = cache.get(msgId)
      if (isRecallMarked(record) && prev && hasContent(prev)) → record.elements = prev.elements; record.msgType = prev.msgType; record.sendStatus=2?; log REWRITE
      else cache.set(msgId, deepClone(record))
- isRecallMarked(record): 
    - record.elements empty/undefined while prev had elements, OR
    - elements contain elementType === 1010/7 or text "撤回"

Implementation details:
- Walk: for payload objects, look for keys "msgList", "messages", "msgs", "records" arrays of msg-like objects (has msgId or msgSeq).
- For each msg: id = msg.msgId || msg.msgSeq; chatId = msg.chatId || msg.peerUid || ""; text = extractText(msg); 
- extractText: iterate msg.elements: if el.textElement?.content → append; if el.content?.text? etc. Join.
- Recall tip detection: /撤回了一条消息|已撤回|recalled/.test(text)
- On tip: find best cached entry: same chatId && same senderUid, latest by msgTime; if found → set tipText = original text of that cache entry → log REWRITE_TIP. Keep it simple.
- Cache: store every msg with text (non-empty, non-tip) into Map key `${chatId}|${id}`, and a list per chatId sorted by time for matching (keep last 200 per chat for tips).

Also we must avoid rewriting our own outgoing pushes for *invites* etc. Only text.

Edge: our own sending of a message containing "撤回" text would be misdetected — require the tip text to *end* with those words or be short.

'.'+n.className.split(' ').filter(Boolean).slice(0,3).join('.') : '') + ' attrs=' + JSON.stringify([...n.attributes].map(a=>a.name+'='+a.value).slice(0,8))); n = n.parentElement; }

  });

Fix: avoid backticks in the content. Use single quotes or plain text.

const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const DIR = global.__qqPluginDir || path.join(process.env.HOME, "Library/Logs/QQPlugin");
const LOG = path.join(DIR, "anti-recall.log");
const log = ...

const RECALL_TIP_RE = /撤回了一条消息|撤回了一条内容|已撤回|recalled|撤回了一条/;
const MSG_EVENT_RE = /nodeIKernelMsgListener\/(onMsgInfoListUpdate|onActiveMsgInfoUpdate|onAddSendMsg)|onMsgInfoListUpdate|onActiveMsgInfoUpdate|MsgInfo|onRecvMsg/;
const GRAY_TIP_TYPE = 8;

map caches:
const byId = new Map();      // peer|msgId -> {elementsJson, msgType, subMsgType, text, sender, time}
const byChat = new Map();    // peer -> array of ids (bounded)

function peerOf(msg){ return String(msg.peerUid || msg.channelId || msg.guildId || msg.chatId || ""); }
function idOf(msg){ const v = msg.msgId || msg.msgSeq || ""; return String(v); }

function contentOfElement(el){
  if(!el) return "";
  if(el.textElement && typeof el.textElement.content === "string") return el.textElement.content;
  if(el.grayTipElement){

then echo \"找不到 $SRC_APP\"; exit 1; fi\n\necho \"== 1/8 复制 QQ.app 到可写位置\"\nrm -rf \"$DEST_APP\"\nmkdir -p \"$(dirname \"$DEST_APP\")\"\nditto \"$SRC_APP\" \"$DEST_APP\"\n\necho \"== 2/8 生成去沙箱 entitlement\"\ncodesign -d --entitlements :- \"$SRC_APP\" > \"$ENT\" 2>/dev/null\n/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c \"Delete :com.apple.security.app-sandbox\" \"$ENT\" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\n/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c \"Add :com.apple.security.cs.allow-dyld-environment-variables bool true\" \"$ENT\" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\n/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c \"Add :com.apple.security.get-task-allow bool true\" \"$ENT\" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\n\necho \"== 3/8 改写主进程入口\"\nnode - \"$DEST_APP/Contents/Resources/app/package.json\" <<'EOF'\nconst fs = require(\"fs\");\nconst p = process.argv[2];\nconst pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, \"utf8\"));\npkg.main = \"./plugin-entry.js\";\nfs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2));\nEOF\n\necho \"== 4/8 安装插件文件\"\ncp \"$HERE/src/plugin-entry.js\" \"$HERE/src/devtools.js\" \"$HERE/src/anti-recall.js\" \"$DEST_APP/Contents/Resources/app/\"\n\necho \"== 5/8 深度重签名（无沙箱）\"\ncodesign --force --deep --sign - --entitlements \"$ENT\" \"$DEST_APP\"\ncodesign -v \"$DEST_APP\" && echo \"签名校验通过\"\n\necho \"== 6/8 复用原数据目录\"\nmkdir -p \"$DATA\"\nif [ -L \"$LINK\" ]; 生成 ~/Applications/QQ-patched.app 并安装插件\\n./run.sh        # 启动（必须直接跑二进制，open 会报 -10810）\\n./uninstall.sh  # 移除复制体\\n\\\\`\\\\`\\\\`\\n\\n\\\\`install.sh\\\\` 还会做两件运行期必需的事：\\n\\n- 创建 \\\\`~/Library/Logs/QQPlugin/blockrelaunch.on\\\\`：QQ 主进程在登录成功时会自己调用 \\\\`app.quit\\\\` / \\\\`app.exit\\\\` / \\\\`app.relaunch\\\\`（栈来自 \\\\`application.asar/42.background.js\\\\`），不拦就会“登录后重启回登录页”。拦截后登录直接进入主界面，插件也会在登录页自动点一次“登录”。\\n- 把当前版本写进 \\\\`versions/config.json\\\\` 的 \\\\`onErrorVersions\\\\` 并设为只读：否则启动器判定复制包未公证，会下载全量更新并重启。\\n\\n## 日志\\n\\n| 文件 | 内容 |\\n| --- | --- |\\n| \\\\`~/Library/Logs/QQPlugin/plugin.log\\\\` | 插件启动、IPC 补丁、生命周期拦截、每条 cmdName 首现记录 |\\n| \\\\`~/Library/Logs/QQPlugin/anti-recall.log\\\\` | \\\\`RESTORE_MSG\\\\`（已还原消息）、\\\\`REWRITE_TIP\\\\`（已改写提示）、\\\\`TIP_NO_CACHE\\\\`（无缓存可还原） |\\n| \\\\`~/Library/Logs/QQPlugin/captures/*.json\\\\` | 命中关键词的完整 IPC payload，用于核对真实结构 |\\n| \\\\`~/Library/Logs/QQPlugin/cmd\\\\` / \\\\`out\\\\` | 在渲染层执行一段 JS 并取回结果（调试通道） |\\n| \\\\`~/Library/Logs/QQPlugin/mcmd\\\\` / \\\\`mout\\\\` | 在主进程执行一段 JS 并取回结果（调试通道） |\\n\\n## 自测\\n\\n1. 启动并登录后打开一个真人会话（文件传输助手是自聊会话，QQ 不允许撤回）。\\n2. 让对方发一条消息并撤回，或自己发一条后 2 分钟内撤回。\\n3. \\\\`anti-recall.log\\\\` 出现 \\\\`RESTORE_MSG\\\\` 或 \\\\`REWRITE_TIP\\\\` 即为生效；界面上原消息内容仍在。\\n\\n## 已知限制\\n\\n- 缓存只在进程内，重启 QQ 后需要重新收到消息才会重新缓存；撤回发生在缓存之前时只能改写提示文案、拿不到原文。\\n- 提示改写依赖“同会话、同发送者”的最近一条缓存，多人会话连续撤回可能匹配到更早一条。\\n- 复制体不会随官方 QQ 自动升级；官方升级后重跑 \\\\`install.sh\\\\`（并更新 \\\\`install.sh\\\\` 里的版本号）即可。\\n- 去掉沙箱后 QQ 运行在非沙箱环境，数据目录改用 \\\\`~/Library/Application Support/QQ\\\\` 软链到原 container。\\n`;\\nawait tools.write({ file_path: work + \\\"/README.md\\\", content: md });\\nconsole.log(\\\"readme written\\\");\", \"description\": \"Rewrite README with current facts\"}"
}

## 现在的状态

`~/Applications/QQ-patched.app` 正在跑（已登录账号 3365263471），撤回拦截挂在主进程的 `WebContents.prototype.send` 上，三条路径同时生效：

1. **缓存**：每条推送来的消息按 `peerUid|msgId` 存整条记录（`elements`、`msgType`、`records`、`sendStatus` 等），并落盘到 `~/Library/Logs/QQPlugin/cache.json`，重启后仍然可用。
2. **还原**：收到 `elementType: 8` 的撤回 grayTip 或带 `recallTime` 的消息，把缓存内容写回再交给渲染层 —— 界面上原来的消息原样留着。
3. **兜底改写**：缓存里没有这条消息时，把“撤回了一条消息”改写成“撤回了一条消息（已拦截，原文：…）”，至少能看到内容。

## 实测结果

- `RESTORE_MSG peer=u_8eZe3rXBJXPL_VbJmhp6Uw id=8888000000000000001 text=ORIGINAL-TEXT-TO-KEEP` —— 还原成功
- `REWRITE_TIP … text=2116484414971-TSET-LLACER-ITNA` —— 缓存未命中时改写成功
- 重启后 `cache loaded entries=193`，对重启前缓存的真实消息发撤回，仍然记 `RESTORE_MSG`

## 需要妹妹配合一步

文件传输助手是自聊会话，右键菜单里只有“删除”，没有“撤回”，我造不出真实撤回。找个好友会话撤回一条（或者自己发一条后 2 分钟内撤回），我读 `~/Library/Logs/QQPlugin/anti-recall.log` 确认界面是否保留原文。

## 使用方式

```bash
cd work/qq-anti-recall
./run.sh        # 启动（自动点登录、跳过更新检查）
./uninstall.sh  # 卸载，恢复原 QQ
```

- 日志：`plugin.log`（生命周期与 send 事件）、`anti-recall.log`（拦截记录）、`captures/`（原始 payload）
- 源码：`src/`（`plugin-entry.js`、`devtools.js`、`anti-recall.js`），`install.sh` 一键重装

## 已知限制

- 缓存从插件启动后才开始积累，插件启动前就存在的老消息撤回时只能走改写路径。
- 多人会话里如果对方撤回一条而从没被缓存过，改写会挂到该会话最近一条有文本的消息上，可能不是同一条。
- 复制体不会跟随 QQ 自动升级，QQ 出新版本需要重跑 `install.sh`。

Renderer JS for opening chat — reuse earlier recipe:
```js
(async () => {
  const inp = document.querySelector('input[placeholder="搜索"]');
  if (!inp) return 'no search input';
  const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set;
  inp.focus(); setter.call(inp, '文件传输助手'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true}));
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));
  const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.recent-contact-item')].filter(e=>e.innerText.includes('文件传输助手'));
  if (!items.length) return 'no item ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.recent-contact-item')].map(e=>e.innerText.slice(0,20)).join('|');
  const el = items[0];
  for (const t of ['mousedown','mouseup','click']) el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(t,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0}));
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000));
  return 'opened';
})()
```
executeJavaScript needs the code to be an expression returning a promise — pass `"(" + code + ")()"`? executeJavaScript evaluates expression; a promise result is awaited by Electron (returns Promise). If code is an IIFE it's fine.

## 刚才为什么会消失

QQ 在登录成功后会自己走一遍退出流程（`app.quit / exit / relaunch`，调用点在 `application.asar/42.background.js:1:1369225`）。插件把这些调用拦了下来，阻止了重启，但 QQ 已经把窗口隐藏掉了——拦住了退出、没把窗口拉回来，就变成“进程活着、窗口不见了”。

刚补的修复：每次拦下退出后 400 毫秒检查一次，如果没有可见窗口就把主窗口 `show()` + `focus()` 回来（日志记 `RESHOW main window shown=true`）。另外加了 `~/Library/Logs/QQPlugin/allowquit.on` 开关，想彻底退出 QQ 时先 `touch` 这个文件，退出就不再被拦。
